reviews.title: Best value, quiet and colorful
reviews.comment: These are a great value, I got three fans and a hub controller for less than other packs that come without a controller. ARGB: My Mobo does not have an ARGB header so I'm able to have argb with the controller, there are many solid colors and combinations. the white on full brightness looks a little more yellow than when on lower brightness but it's not a big deal to me. NOISE: Not bad at all, no rattling and very quiet. I only noticed the air through the fans when on much higher RPMs but i don't mind that sound at all. FAN SPEEDS: I noticed that the product picture of controller showing to plug one fan on port 7 for PWM control is incorrect as I plugged mine on the white slot which is port 12 and the others on 11, 10 and so forth. I plugged the PWM cable to my Mobo 4pin sys fan 1 header and I can control speeds by temp. Overall, very happy with this purchase.
reviews.author: Andriks Salvatierra
